title: Reading and Writing Adaptive Practice Form
disclaimer: Unofficial, original practice material; not affiliated with or endorsed by College Board. SAT is a trademark of College Board. All passages, people, studies, and data are invented for this form.

timing.note: 36 minutes per module keeps the real exam's pace of about 71 seconds per question.

routing.rule: Module 1 raw score of 18 or more out of 30 (60%) routes to the higher Module 2; 17 or fewer routes to the lower Module 2.
routing.note: This is the routing rule for this practice form only. The real exam routes students with an item-response-theory model and does not publish a raw cutoff.

deviations: 60 questions (30 per module) as specified for this form; the real Reading and Writing section has 54 (27 per module, including unscored pretest questions).
36 minutes per module instead of 32, keeping the real pace per question.
Routing uses a stated raw-score threshold instead of an item-response-theory model.
Scores are reported as raw scores with domain and skill breakdowns; no 200-800 scaled score is estimated.
Each domain has exactly 15 items (25%); the real exam weights domains slightly differently.
